title: Holiness of God
definition: The Holiness of God means God is perfectly pure, set apart from all evil, and glorious in all His ways.
summary: The Holiness of God means God is perfectly pure, set apart from all evil, and glorious in all His ways.
christFocus: Jesus reveals God's holiness without distance from sinners: He is the sinless Son who draws near, bears sin, and makes unholy people clean by His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's holiness means He is not common, corrupt, or compromised. He is utterly pure, perfectly righteous, and worthy of reverent worship. Nothing in Him is false, stained, selfish, or unjust.

Scripture's vision of holiness exposes human sin, but it also reveals God's mercy. The Holy One does not lower His standard to save sinners; He provides atonement. Holiness shows why sin is serious and why grace is so costly.

In Christ, God's holiness does not push the repentant sinner away. Jesus, the Holy One, comes near to cleanse, forgive, and make a people holy by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often think holiness only means rules or rejection. Scripture shows something greater: God's holiness is His beautiful purity, and it is the reason evil will not have the final word.

This doctrine helps the ashamed person understand why sin cannot be ignored and why the cross is such good news. The same God who is holy has made a way for sinners to come near in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach God with reverence, honesty, and hope. Confess sin without hiding, trust Christ to cleanse you, and ask the Holy Spirit to form holy desires, holy habits, and holy worship in your daily life.
